# Trove

> Two layers: a Rust engine that indexes what is in a codebase, and a Claude Code plugin that remembers what you decided.

Canonical page: https://anishfyi.com/trove/
Source: https://github.com/anishfyi/trove
Version at time of writing: 0.2.0
Author: Anish Kr Singh (anishfyi), https://anishfyi.com/

## What it is

Trove indexes a repository once into symbols, modules, subsystems and an architecture map, then retrieves only what a task needs. A Claude Code plugin adds durable memory for decisions and gotchas.

## Facts

- The engine indexes into five levels: L1 symbols, L2 per-file module summaries, L3 subsystem clusters, L4 a repo-wide architecture and data-flow map, and L5 imported historical entries.
- Symbols are extracted for Rust, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, Go and Bash.
- Retrieval stops as soon as it has enough detail, so unused context budget is treated as healthy rather than wasted.
- The engine writes to `.trove/` in any repository and is driven by a Rust CLI with `index`, `status`, `query`, `import-historical`, `record` and `patch`.
- The Claude Code plugin stores personal engineering memory (decisions, gotchas, conventions) in `~/.claude/trove` or `./.claude/trove`, captured with `/trove:remember` and searched with `/trove:recall`.
- MIT licensed, current version 0.2.0.

## Questions and answers

### What is Trove?

Trove makes LLMs operate over repositories and knowledge bases far larger than their native context window. Instead of stuffing more tokens into the prompt, it indexes everything once and retrieves only what matters, at the right level of detail.

### What is the difference between the Trove engine and the Trove plugin?

The engine is a Rust CLI that writes a `.trove/` index in any repository and answers what is in this codebase and where. The plugin is a Claude Code plugin storing personal engineering memory in `~/.claude/trove` and answers what did we decide and why.

### How do I index a repository with Trove?

Build the CLI with `cargo build -p trove-cli`, then run `trove-cli index` in the repository. `trove-cli status` shows what was indexed and `trove-cli query "<task>"` retrieves context for a task.

### Which languages does the Trove symbol index support?

Rust, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, Go and Bash.

### How do I install the Trove Claude Code plugin?

Inside Claude Code run `/plugin marketplace add anishfyi/trove`, then `/plugin install trove@anishfyi-trove`, then `/reload-plugins`, then `/trove:init` to create your personal trove.

### Does Trove replace a bigger context window?

It addresses a different problem. A bigger window lets you paste more; Trove lets you paste less, by retrieving the architecture, subsystem, module or symbol that a specific task actually needs and stopping there.
